chapters.title: Thermal Queue Governor
chapters.body: Recorded interactive walkthrough · synthetic motor data

chapters.title: 1 · Explore the motor
chapters.body: Click the windings to see what they do and how effort produces heat.

chapters.title: 2 · Inspect the drive electronics
chapters.body: The controller, inverter, capacitor, and sensors are clickable schematic parts.

chapters.title: 3 · A clipped sensor can hide a hotter motor
chapters.body: The reading stops at 95°C; the governor keeps an upper temperature bound.

chapters.title: 4 · Accepted commands still have to execute
chapters.body: The governor accounts for all eight queued commands before admitting more effort.

chapters.title: 5 · Compare the optional waiting scheduler
chapters.body: This demo mode waits for full effort and rejects requests after 20 simulated seconds.

chapters.title: 6 · Review the measured simulation results
chapters.body: Effort delivered, completed and rejected commands, and over-limit samples update from the run.

chapters.title: Explore it yourself
chapters.body: Same scalar governor · detailed hardware illustration · no physical motor or electrical circuit test
